spans.s:
सेन सेन (स-इन), अस्, आ, अम्, having a lord,
possessing a master or leader.

. said to
be fr. rt. सि, ‘to bind;’ according to some fr. सेन
above), an army, armament, armed force; an Army
personified as the wife of Kārttikeya; N. of the
mother of the third Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī.
—सेन-जित्, त्, m. (for सेना-जित्), a proper N.
—सेना-
कल्प, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva.
—सेनाग्र (˚ना-अग्˚),
अम्, n. the front or van of an army.
—सेनाग्र-ग,
अस्, m. ‘going at the front of an army,’ the leader of
an army, general.
—सेनाङ्ग (˚ना-अङ्˚), अम्, n. a
component part of an army (supposed to be con-
stituted of four divisions, viz. elephants, chariots,
cavalry, and infantry).
—सेना-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, going
with or accompanying an army; (अस्), m. a soldier;
a suttler, camp-follower.
—सेना-जू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved.
inciting an army, outstripping a host.
—सेना-नि-
वेश, अस्, m. the camp of an army.
—सेना-नी, ईस्,
m. (acc. सेनान्यम्, loc. सेनान्याम्, see

.
द्), the leader of an army, commander, general; N.
of Kārttikeya (god of war); epithet of a die
(the head of a host of dice); N. of one of the
eleven Rudras (according to some); of a son of
Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—सेना-पति, इस्, m. ‘army-chief,’
a general; N. of Kārttikeya; of Śiva.
—सेना-
पति-त्व, अम्, n. generalship.
—सेना-परिच्छद्, त्,
त्, त्, surrounded by an army.
—सेना-पुर, अम्, n.,
N. of a city.
—सेना-पृष्ठ, अम्, n. the rear of an
army.
—सेना-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the breaking of an
army, rout, disorderly flight.
—सेना-मुख, अम्, n.
[]
a division or battalion of an army, a company con-
sisting of three Pattis (or three elephants, three
chariots, nine horse and fifteen foot; see पत्ति); a
mound or covered way in front of a city gate.
—सेना-
योग, अस्, m. the equipment of an army.
—सेना-
रक्ष, अस्, m. ‘army-protector,’ a guard, sentinel.
—सेना-विन्दु, उस्, m., N. of a king.
सेनक सेनक, अस्, m., N. of a grammarian.

सेनय, Nom. P. सेनयति, &c. See अभि-षे-
णय, p. 68, col. 2.

सेन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to an army, re-
sembling an army.

सेन्द्र सेन्द्र (स-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, accom-
panied by Indra, together with Indra.

सेन्द्रगण (स-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, together with
the troops of Indra.

सेन्द्रचाप (स-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, along with the
bow of Indra.

सेन्द्रायुध-तडित् (˚र-आय्˚), त्, त्, त्, with a rain-
bow and lightning.

सेन्द्रायुध-पुरोगम, अस्, आ, अम्, preceded
by the rainbow.

सेन्द्रिय सेन्द्रिय (स-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
organs of sense, with the organs of sense.
